text:
### Key Documents  
- Application Landscape (APP-LAND-001)
- Context Diagram (CTX-DIAG-001)
- Logical Data Model (LDM-001)
- API Catalogue (API-CAT-001)
- Integration Specification (INT-SPEC-001)  
**See:** [[systems]]
name: Chunk 75/102

raw_entities.name: Application Landscape
raw_entities.description: Comprehensive documentation of the bank's application portfolio and technology ecosystem, providing visibility into all systems and their relationships.

raw_entities.name: Context Diagram
raw_entities.description: Visual representation documenting the system boundaries, external dependencies, and integration points across the FirstUK Bank technology landscape.

raw_entities.name: Logical Data Model
raw_entities.description: Formal specification of the bank's data entities, relationships, and attributes that underpin core banking operations and customer interactions.

raw_entities.name: API Catalogue
raw_entities.description: Centralized registry and documentation of all application programming interfaces exposed by FirstUK Bank systems for internal and external integration.

raw_entities.name: Integration Specification
raw_entities.description: Technical specification defining integration patterns, protocols, and requirements for connecting systems within the FirstUK Bank architecture.

properties.purpose: Provides overview of applications and their relationships within the organization
Illustrates system boundaries and external interfaces
Defines data entities, attributes, and relationships independent of physical implementation
Catalogs available APIs and their specifications for system integration
Defines integration patterns and protocols between systems
